description: Answers "Which of my holdings has a problem?" or "Screen these tickers for red flags before the open". Give up to 10 tickers, CIKs or company names. Returns a ranking (most red flags first, then amber) with each company's flags and one-paragraph summary, and every company's full dossier: profile, four fiscal years of financials and the latest quarter, the last five 8-K events, insider buying and selling over the latest 10 Form 4s, the latest 10-K/10-Q, and flags (RED: restatements, delisting notices, bankruptcy, late 10-Ks; AMBER: auditor changes, cybersecurity incidents, impairments, late 10-Qs, losses, cash burn, negative equity, shrinking revenue; GREEN: profitable growth, insider buying), each citing its filing. Priced by size: $0.03 for the first company and $0.025 for each further one (2 companies $0.055, 3 $0.08, 4 $0.105, 5 $0.13), capped at $0.15 for 6 to 10, always less than separate company_dossier calls. The 402 answer quotes the exact price for your list. Companies that cannot be found are listed in `failed`; if none can, you are not charged. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.03 to $0.15 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

tickers.description: Up to 10 companies: tickers (e.g. "NVDA"), CIKs (e.g. 320193) or exact company names.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
